name: accessing_tostring_of_features_map_9a149496
subject: Fix accessing `toString` of features map (#52340)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Fixes accessing toString of the script target features map. Plain object key lookup picked up Object.prototype members, so the features map is converted to a real Map. The symptom is most likely a crash or wrong result on property names like toString.
